description: The African Transport Systems Database - a geospatial database of multi-modal connected networks is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Silvia Colombo et al. We present the first complete geolocated multi-modal transport database for the whole continent of Africa, the African Transport Systems Database (AfTS-Db), including road, rail, aviation, maritime and inland waterway networks. Coverage: continental; published in 2025. Formats: CSV, Excel, GeoPackage. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
